translations.web: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.
translations.bsb: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.
translations.kjv: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.
translations.asv: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have asked for: and, behold, Jehovah hath set a king over you.
